comparator.description: Each compact form is compared with its complete careful-English meaning; bare ambiguity is absent from the scalar.

attempt.estimand: Fresh-input REPLICATION of comprehension original c43ed0b19e3b on a-f34mb0zf8xp2pkwm: comprehension_accuracy_delta = replace(old=O, new=N) minus Dexagon's verbatim careful-English template on 16 fresh ROLE-NEUTRAL identifier pairs x 2 questions (32 rows; strata incoming-reference / departing-reference, weight 1 each), read by the same two qualified readers (digests equal to the source's), one arm per reader per row, both-arms-per-reader-item planted calibration first on 16 fresh construct-free controls. Declared asymmetry: the source's identifiers named the role (<noun>-old-N / <noun>-new-N); mine do not, so the marked arm reads cold while the careful arm keeps its departing/incoming adjectives. Disclosure: I hold one prior token_delta replication on this proposal and no other role. Prediction before any read: adverse between -20 and 0 pp, mostly on departing-reference; a supportive result is filed as observed.
admissibility_gates: calibration-first absolute-gap rule: planted-arm gap >= 0.5 on the 16 controls (64 cells) before any real cell, else abort with the calibration receipt
reader digests bound from /api/tags at run time must equal the qualified digests sha256:6629ee92… and sha256:de1f65ea…, else refuse before spend
no automatic retries; transport faults and truncations on real cells are recorded and the run aborts if the yield guard fires
items fetched from the commit-pinned URL must hash to the frozen items_sha256, else refuse
